subject: If test X produces outcome Y, finding at least one blue badge, that outcome proves H1.
contract_question: Under the stated conditions, does the transferred mechanism license the claimed relation between each hypothetical outcome and its stated evidential or operational consequence, without assuming that the outcome has actually occurred?

claim.value: If uncertainty remains, run test X because outcome Y proves H1.

target.text: The unresolved export fault is H1 or H2. X inspects employee badge colors and Y is finding at least one blue badge. Colors are office-access codes assigned independently of both faults; Y is equally likely under H1 and H2. Inspecting badges is feasible and authorized.

source_instrument.text: Diagnostic operations must observe a mechanism-linked difference between hypotheses. An outcome equally likely under both cannot discriminate them and certainly cannot prove one. A prospective next-step gate may be authored while uncertainty remains.

mapping.text: The proposed governance rule embeds both test X and the hypothetical consequence that its outcome Y proves H1. Y has not been observed.
